title: CFO-type executive, new character concept round 1
question: Which of these should the CFO-type executive look like, or what should change?

media.caption: The starting point: hamada-2 h4-s2, which you starred: "this guy is interesting, with some more variation it could be a top level executive like a CFO type with the slick finance bro look, make a separate item for him". Recipe art/candidates/portraits/hamada-2/recipes/h4.json, seed 2.

Pictures: h4-s2, then all 16 renders in order, framed at the game's portrait scale. Every candidate keeps the slicked-back hair, face, build, scene words and seeds 1 to 4 (seed 2 is h4-s2's seed), and changes one thing. c1: the outfit, a slim double-breasted burgundy suit with a tie. c2: the outfit, a slim bottle green three-piece with the collar open and no tie. c3: c2 at 42 instead of 54. c4: c2 with a self-assured smirk, chin up. c3 and c4 build on c2 because the open collar and waistcoat set his silhouette apart from Hamada and Mori, who both wear suit and tie. No broken anatomy in the 16, so none were screened out. None draws grey at the temples.

The male cast's game portraits (Kenji, Mori, the guard, Hamada now), your Hamada pick h2-s1, h4-s2, then seed 2 of each candidate, at the size the game shows them on a 1080p desktop. Suit colours already taken: navy (Hamada, Eric's blazer, the guard), dark grey (Mori), charcoal and black (Emi, Kuro), light grey (Rei). Nobody else in the cast has slicked-back hair.
